title: ODS Score Output v1
description: Output of `ods score --json`: the technical-debt impact of a change, combining AI detection, quality analysis, test coverage, and duplication signals.

pr_number.description: Pull request number, when known. Omitted otherwise.

technical_debt_delta.description: Weighted technical-debt impact. Higher positive = more debt added; negative = debt reduced.

verdict.description: Direction of the debt delta: increase (> 0), decrease (< 0), neutral (rounds to 0.0). Not a risk level — see risk.

risk.description: Band the delta falls in: low (<= 1.0), moderate (<= 3.0), high (<= 5.0), critical (> 5.0). Optional: older CLIs omit it and carried the band in the recommendation text.

recommendation.description: Human-readable guidance derived from the risk band.

files_analyzed.description: Number of files included in the score.

Breakdown.description: The dimensional scores that combine into technical_debt_delta.

ai_code_ratio.description: AI lines / total changed code lines. 0 when ai_code_ratio_source is unknown: no per-file attribution exists and no ratio is claimed.

ai_code_ratio_source.description: Provenance of the AI-line numerator: measured by git-ai authorship notes, attested by the code lines AI-attributed commits added, estimated by the diff heuristics, or unknown (nothing measured or attested). Optional: older CLIs omit it.

critical_issues.description: Count of critical + high severity issues.

test_coverage.description: Line coverage rate (0.0–1.0). -1 means not measured.

test_coverage_source.description: How test_coverage was obtained. 'unknown' means it was not measured.

duplication_rate.description: Estimated fraction of duplicated lines among the change's added code lines. Non-code files are excluded; a change with no code lines reports 0.
